name: Xuzhou Handler Special Vehicle Co., Ltd.
summary: Xuzhou Handler Special Vehicle Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of special-purpose vehicles in China and internationally. The company offers mobile elevating work platforms, including insulated aerial and aerial work platforms; fire engines, such as fire trucks and robots; and power supply vehicles, as well as custom emergency vehicles. It also provides emergency vehicle solutions for construction, energy, public utilities, firefighting, warehouse logistics, electric power, telecommunications, and rail industries. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Xuzhou, China.
